svg.title: Yunmen
svg.desc: Yunmen in a browser, with a host list and terminal tabs running tmux, next to a work laptop terminal running yunmen connect. SSH keys stay on the gateway; access needs Cloudflare Access, a password and TOTP; files can be browsed, uploaded and downloaded; a single device can be revoked.
svg.metadata: Original Yunmen artwork. Lettering outlined from Noto Sans, Noto Sans Mono and Noto Sans CJK SC, licensed under SIL OFL 1.1. This SVG is artwork, not a redistributed font. Generated by docs/assets/make-hero.py.
